site.title: Soul for U
site.description: A soulful page written just for you
site.author: Anonymous

subtitle.en: Every soul that wanders the night is looking for another light to answer it. This page is that answer — written only for you.
subtitle.zh: 每一个在夜里流浪的灵魂，都在寻找另一束回应它的光。这一页，就是那束光——只为你而写。

en: It is not a product. It is not even a place. It is a quiet room inside the noise — a small corner of the universe reserved for one person.
Here, time slows down. Starlight becomes language, silence becomes music, and every word you read was placed here gently, like a stone skipped across still water, hoping to reach your shore.
If you have ever felt unseen, this page exists to say: someone noticed. Someone always did.
zh: 它不是一件商品，甚至不是一个地方。它是喧嚣中的一间静室——宇宙里专属于一个人的小小角落。
在这里，时间放慢了脚步。星光成为语言，寂静成为音乐。你读到的每一句话，都被轻轻放在这里，像一颗掠过静水的石子，只为抵达你的岸边。
如果你曾觉得自己不被看见，那么这一页存在的意义就是告诉你：有人注意到了你，一直都有的。

description.en: Somewhere above the clouds there is a star quietly carrying your name. It has been burning long before we met, and will keep burning after.
description.zh: 云层之上，有一颗星星正安静地承载着你的名字。它在相遇之前就已燃烧，也将在之后继续燃烧。

description.en: For the nights when the world feels too heavy — may this little flame remind you that darkness is only where light chooses to rest.
description.zh: 当世界变得沉重、夜色漫过肩头时——愿这簇小小的火苗提醒你：黑暗，不过是光选择休息的地方。

description.en: The most honest gift of all: a blank page, because our story has not finished being written. The next line belongs to you.
description.zh: 这是最诚实的礼物：一张空白的纸。因为我们的故事尚未写完，下一行，属于你。

en: "In a universe of a trillion galaxies, two souls chose the same tiny blue dot, at the same breath of time. Do not call that coincidence."
"You are not a drop in the ocean. You are the entire ocean, folded small enough to fit inside one heartbeat."
"Some people are sentences. You are punctuation — the pause that gives every story meaning."
zh: 「在亿万星系之中，两个灵魂在同一缕时间里，选中了同一颗微小的蓝色星球。别把那称作巧合。」
「你不是沧海之一粟。你是整片海洋，只是被折叠得足够小，刚好装进一次心跳。」
「有些人是句子，而你是标点——是那个让所有故事有了意义的停顿。」

content.en:
Dear you,

I do not know when you will read this, or who you will have become by then. Perhaps the years will have taught you armor; perhaps they will have taught you wings.

Either way, I hope one thing stays unchanged — that somewhere deep inside, you still believe in gentle things: late-night conversations, unexplained kindnesses, and souls that find each other without asking why.

This whole page is my way of saying: I thought of you today.
And tomorrow, probably, again.
content.zh:
亲爱的你：

我不知道你会何时读到这封信，也不知道那时的你变成了什么模样。也许岁月教会了你铠甲，也许教会了你翅膀。

无论如何，我希望有一件事从未改变——在你内心深处，你依然相信那些温柔的事物：深夜的长谈、不问缘由的善意，以及不必追问为何就能彼此找到的灵魂。

这整整一页，都是我想说的话：今天，我想起了你。
明天，大概也是。
